A backslash followed by a single quote (e.g., `\''`) in SQL will be interpreted as an escaped single quote, but when this sequence is placed directly into a Python string without escaping the backslash, it becomes `\'` which closes the string prematurely. The fix is to also escape backslashes in addition to quotes.
